column1: # How each third-party component linked into libembedded_mongodb_native.so is accounted for
# in the notices published beside it. scripts/collect-third-party-notices reads the Bazel link
# command and fails on any component that is not listed here, so adding a dependency cannot
# The package names are exactly what appears in the link: a Bazel package under the MongoDB
# checkout, or an `external/<repo>` for one Bazel fetched.
#   upstream <heading>   Covered by a numbered section in mongo/distsrc/THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.
#                        <heading> is the text after "License notice for", checked to exist.
#   append   <path>      Not in that file. Its licence text lives at <path>, relative to the
#                        MongoDB checkout or the Bazel execroot, and is appended verbatim.
#   absent   <reason>    Must NOT be in the link. Present means a build flag regressed.
#   review   <reason>    Linked, with no licence text available in the checkout. Publishing
#                        is blocked until a human resolves it.
#   ours     <path>      Not third-party: this project's own code, under LICENSE and NOTICE.

column3: 3rd party software included in the WiredTiger library

column1: # Linked, and MongoDB's notices do not cover them: their inventory marks both as not
# distributed in release binaries, because MongoDB links them only in their own tooling.
# libdwarf is the reason: it is LGPL-2.1, and a stripped, LTO'd, version-scripted static
# library gives a recipient no way to relink against a modified copy. cpptrace is MIT and
# would only have needed its notice, but it is the only thing that pulls libdwarf in.
# Reaches the link through the authorization and replication mocks in
# embedded-mongodb-sys/native/BUILD.bazel, which the embedded server installs deliberately.
# MongoDB's checkout ships no licence text for it -- their overlay replaces the upstream
# repository root -- so there is nothing to append and nothing upstream covers it.

column3: no licence text in the checkout; decide before publishing
